title: What Rest Does Jesus Give?
question: What is the weariness Jesus invites us to bring Him, and what kind of rest does He promise in return?
blurb: Jesus calls the weary and burdened to come to Him - and what He offers in return is more than a pause from work.

nodes.content: What is the weariness Jesus invites us to bring Him, and what kind of rest does He promise in return?

nodes.verseText: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.

nodes.content: Notice who is invited: 'all you who are weary and burdened' - no qualifier but exhaustion itself. The condition for coming is simply that you need rest.
Jesus says 'I will give you rest' - rest is a gift He hands over, not a wage we earn. The action He asks of us is only to 'come.'
